title: How to organize the pet station | Mudroom
description:
Everything the animal needs to get out of the door, and everything you need when it comes back through it filthy.

This is the Pet Station in the Mudroom. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Lead clipped to collar on one hook with a full roll of waste bags attached, an old towel folded within arm's reach of the door, food sealed in a bin with the scoop inside it, and every treatment behind a closed door above the animal's nose and above a toddler's reach.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Lay out every lead, collar, harness and chewed toy you can find in this room.
Straighten: Hang the walking kit as one connected unit, lead clipped to collar with the bag roll threaded on, so leaving t
Shine: Wash the scoop and wipe the crumbs and oils out of the bin before you refill it, rather than tipping fresh foo
Safety: Flea, tick and worming treatments are poison to a child and to an animal of the wrong size, so they live in a
Standardize: Refill the bin when the level drops to the scoop, and keep one spare bag roll behind the one in use.
Sustain: When you clip the lead back on its hook after a walk, check the bag roll and swap it if it is down to the last

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Lead, collar and a full bag roll hang together as one kit, and treatments stay behind a closed door above reach.
